messages:
cameron: Quick ask: can someone run a short continuous-batching throughput sweep on the small-window profile (max_tokens=512) using loadgen profile `burst-50-1s` and capture a queue-length heatmap? Need numbers for a customer perf call tomorrow. cc @ria @henry
ria: On it. Which model variant do you want—baseline fp16 or baseline -> q4 fallback chain?
henry: I'd run baseline first then q4 fallback. Also please cap `max_batch_tokens` at 1024 and record per-shard GC pauses + CPU steal. We'll want concurrency=8 and 30s warmup.
cameron: Yep baseline + q4 fallback. Concurrency 8, warmup 30s, run 3x 60s windows. Thanks!
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: started job `cb-sweep-2198765432` (id: job-88) with parameters {region: eu-west-1, fleet: dedicated-3}. Logs: https://internal/logs/job-88
ria: Kickoff: run started on aws-eu-west-1-dedicated-3. I'll post heatmaps and a short summary when done.
ria: First pass results: peak throughput ~720 tok/s, 95p lat 210ms, queue tail peaked ~1.2s under burst. Heatmap: https://internal/heatmaps/2198765432.png
cameron: Nice. Two quick followups: (1) capture KV cache hit rate, (2) re-run with `max_tokens=256` to compare.
ria: KV cache hit rate ~0.86 across the run. Re-running with max_tokens=256 now.
henry: FYI I opened PR #4123 to tweak the batching heuristics (adaptive window cap). Might help here.
olivia: On the PR review. Left two small nits, can merge after the unit test is green. :thumbsup:
ria: Second run done (max_tokens=256): peak 830 tok/s, 95p 170ms, queue tail ~0.6s. Heatmap: https://internal/heatmaps/2198765432-2.png
ria: Quick log snippet: ```requests: 1000
errors: 0
avg_q_len: 0.22
kv_hit: 0.84
``` 
cameron: Looks like smaller max_tokens improves both latency and throughput for this loadgen profile. Candidate default for bursty endpoints. Can someone add these results to the runbook and add a regression alert (queue_tail > 1s)?
henry: I'll update the runbook and add a nightly regression job with the burst profile. Also adding an automatic fallback rule: if queue_tail > 1s then route to fallback variant.
ria: Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-perf/cb/2198765432/
cameron: Thanks team—closing loop. If you want raw traces or additional slices ping me.
